items.a: A free desktop app for Warframe on Windows, built on Overwolf. It sits next to the game and bundles inventory, builds, market prices and relic drops — so you stop clicking through ten websites.
The core of the app is free. Optional premium features may arrive later to support development — the core features stay free.
OwnFrame runs on Overwolf — an established platform for gaming apps whose apps go through a review process. OwnFrame does not read credentials and does not interfere with the game.
